source_note: 样本期望的渐近展开系数
english_source_note: Asymptotic Expansion Coefficients of Sample Means
callout_id: 样本期望的渐近展开系数#1
statement_en: Find the limit of the following parameter-dependent integral: $$\lim_{n\to \infty} \int_{[0,1]^n}n\left(\frac{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i^2}{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\,dx_{1}\cdots dx_n$$
key_techniques: rewrite the integral as an expectation
asymptotic expansion of a ratio of sample means
Taylor expansion around the population means
prerequisites: expectation and integration over product spaces
callout_body: 求下面含参数积分的极限:$$\lim_{n\to \infty} \int_{[0,1]^n}n\left(\frac{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i^2}{\sum_{i\leq n} x_i}-\frac{2}{3}\right)\,dx_{1}\cdots dx_n$$
